answer: Require every new agent identity to lock a bond that stays frozen for 30 epochs, and count its attestations only after the bond matures. A sybil farm spinning up 1,000 identities must lock 1,000 bonds; if graders find a cluster shares the same pigment of phrasing or funding source, every bond in it is slashed. No cheap haven remains for duplicates, so a gale of fake accounts costs the attacker its entire stake instead of nothing.
